title: Bakery in Rowland Heights (unincorporated Los Angeles County)
assumptions: The company still has to be formed (an LLC) unless an entity is named. Hires staff. Builds out the space. No new exterior sign (signage: false).

items.name: Articles of Organization (California LLC)
items.feeNote: Fee not read on an official page in this pass (registry says $70).
items.note: SF guide: LLCs "must register their structure with the CA Secretary of State before registering locally."

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Seller's permit
items.agency: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration
items.note: "Every location must have this permit to sell taxable goods." Also on the LA restaurant checklist.

items.name: Employer payroll tax account registration (DE 1)
items.note: Register within 15 days of paying more than $100 in wages in a calendar quarter.

items.name: Food safety (manager) certification, at least one owner or employee
items.agency: Local environmental health agency (California Health and Safety Code 113947.1)
items.note: Within 60 days of opening; valid 5 years.

items.name: California Food Handler Card for food employees
items.agency: Local environmental health agency (California Health and Safety Code 113948)
items.note: Within 30 days of hire; valid 3 years; food managers exempt.

items.name: Fictitious Business Name statement
items.condition: Only when trading under a name other than the legal name.

items.name: Food facility plan check
items.agency: Los Angeles County Department of Public Health, Environmental Health
items.quote: Submit your plans for approval to the EH Plan Check Program; then submit the plans to your local building and safety office for approval.
items.note: County EH covers all of Los Angeles County except Long Beach, Pasadena and Vernon (catering facilities page).

items.name: Public health permit (food facility)
items.agency: Los Angeles County Department of Public Health, Environmental Health
items.match: (public health permit|health permit).*(los angeles county)|(los angeles county).*(public health permit|health permit)
items.quote: After payment of the Public Health Permit fee is made, the permit will be issued.

items.name: Building permit for the build-out (unincorporated)
items.agency: Los Angeles County Public Works, Building and Safety
items.match: (building permit|tenant improvement|build-?out|building and safety).*(public works|los angeles county)|(public works|los angeles county).*(building permit|tenant improvement|build-?out|building and safety)
items.quote: If your property is in unincorporated LA County, LA County Public Works will issue your permit.

items.name: County business license, if the activity is one Title 7 licenses
items.agency: Los Angeles County Treasurer and Tax Collector
items.note: The county licenses only listed activities in unincorporated areas; whether a bakery or restaurant is one wasn't confirmed on an official page.

order.why: IRS: "form your entity through the secretary of state before you apply for an EIN."
Plans approved before construction; the permit is issued after the final inspection and the fee.

mustNotInclude.name: A city business license
mustNotInclude.why: Rowland Heights is unincorporated; there is no city.
mustNotInclude.match: city of rowland heights|rowland heights business license
